answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because terrace only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
